cd /app; python3 << 'EOF'
import subprocess
seqs={}; name=None
for line in open('sequences.fasta'):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('>'): name=line[1:]; seqs[name]=''
    else: seqs[name]+=line
inp=seqs['input']; out=seqs['output']
# insertion site: upstream ends '...atatacatatgag', downstream starts 'caagggc'
up_marker='atatacatatgag'
i=inp.find(up_marker)
site=i+len(up_marker)   # insertion goes here
print('site index', site, 'up ends', inp[site-15:site], 'down starts', inp[site:site+15])
insertion='tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag'
# verify
assert out[:site]==inp[:site]
assert out[site:site+len(insertion)]==insertion
assert out[site+len(insertion):]==inp[site:]
print('verified insertion clean, len', len(insertion))

comp=str.maketrans('acgtACGT','tgcaTGCA')
def rc(s): return s.translate(comp)[::-1]

def tm(s):
    r=subprocess.run(['oligotm','-tp','1','-sc','1','-mv','50','-dv','2','-n','0.8','-d','500',s],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return float(r.stdout.strip())

# forward anneal = downstream top strand
down=inp[site:]
# reverse anneal = revcomp of upstream
up=inp[:site]
for L in range(15,37):
    fa=down[:L]; ra=rc(up[-L:])
    print(L, 'fwd', round(tm(fa),2), 'rev', round(tm(ra),2))
EOF

import subprocess
seqs={}; name=None
for line in open('sequences.fasta'):
    line=line.strip()

    else: seqs[name]+=line
inp=seqs['input']

insertion='tagattagaagaagaattaagaagaagattaacagaaag'

fwd=insertion+fa

with open('primers.fasta','w') as f:
